title: My child repeats inappropriate words heard in the street: From nursery to primary school
summary: If your child (4-6 years old) repeats a foul word they heard in the street, do not magnify the issue with shouting or harsh punishment, as this may fix it in their mind. Teach them in simple words that a Muslim does not hurt people with his tongue, for the Prophet ﷺ said: «A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe» (Sahih al-Bukhari 10). Replace the word with a kind one, and repeat this calmly until the habit fades. Be their example: when they hear you choose the kind word when you are angry or joking, they learn more from you than from being told not to.
try_this: Today: Agree with your child on a kind alternative word to say instead of the inappropriate one, and remind them of it calmly whenever they repeat the inappropriate word.
reflection_prompts: Does your reaction when hearing a foul word embed it in your child’s mind or erase it calmly?
Does your child hear you say the alternative word so they can imitate you?
